scope_warning: DECK-SCOPED, NOT MODEL-SCOPED. PFLOTRAN's mass-balance columns are assembled at runtime from deck-defined couplers and the deck's reactive-transport species list (output_observation.F90), so this is the output surface of the 'scenario1_miniLEO' deck at commit 157a26f7 — a different deck at the same commit has different columns. There is no source-derived mode for this model: scanning source yields the column TEMPLATE, not the column SET.
format_note: The tape is NOT a CSV: the header is comma-separated and quoted, the data rows are fixed-width with zero separators. Cumulative vs rate is decided by the UNITS BRACKET, not the column name, so the FULL header is the key.
